title: Decision Fatigue: Why You Buy Junk at Night

vo.en: Your brain has a daily battery.

visual.description: A close-up shot of a smartphone battery charging icon on a dark screen, transitioning to an abstract glowing light.

vo.en: It’s why you can resist donuts at noon, but find yourself ordering late-night pizza by nine.
vo.fr: C’est pourquoi tu résistes à midi, mais craques pour une pizza à minuit.

visual.description: A man in a kitchen looking at a salad at a table, then a fast cut to a man opening a pizza box in a dark room.

vo.en: Psychologists call this decision fatigue. Every tiny choice, from picking a shirt to answering emails, saps your energy.
vo.fr: C'est la fatigue décisionnelle. Chaque petit choix épuise ton précieux réservoir de volonté.

visual.description: A man’s hands rapidly scrolling through a closet of clothes, then quickly typing on a laptop keyboard.

vo.en: Think of willpower as a finite muscle. By the time evening hits, that muscle is completely exhausted.
vo.fr: Vois la volonté comme un muscle. Le soir venu, ce muscle est totalement à plat.

visual.description: Close-up of a car's fuel gauge moving from full to empty, followed by a tired man rubbing his eyes.

vo.en: This is exactly when your self-control breaks, leading to impulse buys and mindless scrolling.
vo.fr: C'est là que ton contrôle lâche, provoquant des achats impulsifs et du défilement infini.

visual.description: A man’s hand holding a credit card over a laptop at night, then fingers scrolling quickly on a phone.

vo.en: To save your sanity, automate your mornings. Preset your meals and clothes to preserve your mental fuel.
vo.fr: Pour t'en sortir, automatise tes matins. Prépare tout d'avance pour économiser ta force mentale.

visual.description: A man setting out a pre-packed lunch and a neatly folded outfit on a bed in the early morning light.

vo.en: You have to protect your focus, because every morning...
vo.fr: Tu dois protéger ta concentration, car chaque matin...

visual.description: A macro shot of a human eye opening wide, then an abstract animation of neural pathways lighting up.
